title: Board Game Reset Ritual
shareTitle: Board Game Reset Ritual — Breathe, Hug, Tidy, Try Again
description: Help two wooden toy friends recover from a wobbly board-game moment with one slow breath, a cozy hug, and a cooperative tidy-up.
summary: Help Biscuit and Miso breathe, hug, tidy the board, and happily play again together.
learningGoals: Rehearse a three-step calming ritual after disappointment
Practice comforting a friend without blame
Return loose game pieces together and resume play
interactionModel: spin and move a cooperative pair, then tap or drag through breathe, hug, and tidy actions before resuming the board
feedbackModel: recorded teacher narration, warm toy music, tactile wooden movement, gentle modeling, high-five celebration, and no punitive state

modes.title: Reset Together
modes.skill: breathe, hug, tidy, and return to play
